name: right_arm
method: Motors de-energized, every joint dragged by hand onto both mechanical stops.
Angles decoded from the raw 0x2A5/0x2A6/0x2A7 encoder feedback frames and the
gripper from 0x2A8, so no SDK software limit, URDF value or calibration table
is applied. 84612 joint frames and 13198 gripper frames.
